newsitem.title: USA: US budget deal not to affect Fed policy - S.F. Fed.
newsitem.headline: US budget deal not to affect Fed policy - S.F. Fed.

text.p: The balanced budget agreement reached by the White House and the Republican Congress last week is unlikely to change the way the Federal Reserve will conduct monetary policy in the future, said a top official at the Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco.

"I don't think this (accord) is enough of a change in the direction of fiscal policy to matter a great deal to the way monetary policy has to be managed over the next several years," Jack Beebe, director of research at the San Francisco Fed, told Reuters.
